difficulty_reason: For a weakly etale morphism of schemes f : X -> Y the lemma proves f is formally unramified, equivalently Omega_{X/Y} = 0. The retained proof is written as a four-reference descent to rings: the differential criterion for formal unramifiedness (chapter lemma formally-unramified-differentials); the affine-local dictionary from last wave's characterization card (lemma weakly-etale-characterize, card L16119) — reduces the scheme statement to the assertion for ring maps O_Y(V) -> O_X(U) being weakly etale); the affines-to-modules translation for differentials (Morphisms, lemma differentials-affine); and the ring-level theorem that weakly etale ring maps have vanishing module of differentials (More on Algebra, lemma formally-unramified). Each reference carries a specific clause of the reduction. Retained author proof at lines 19047-19054.
